title: A Reduced Stochastic Model of Microservice Availability: Algorithms for Identification and Formal Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2607.00740v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Estimating microservice operation availability requires connecting runtime observations to completion of the required work within a deadline. Detailed architectural models provide one route, but their reconstruction and analysis can be costly. We present algorithms for identifying and analysing a reduced stochastic availability model from telemetry and declared operation requirements. The identification procedure constructs a joint law of execution states and retains compatible laws when observations are incomplete. Formal results establish attainable probability bounds and conditions for identifying a completion-and-deadline representation directly. This construction preserves the range obtained by evaluating the same completion-and-deadline event in the full model; a separate joint comparison describes the structural information discarded. translated_title: 微服务可用性的简化随机模型：识别与形式化分析算法
translated_abstract: 估算微服务的运行可用性，需要将运行时观测数据与所需工作在截止期限内的完成情况联系起来。详细的架构模型提供了一条途径，但其重构与分析的代价可能很高。我们提出了从遥测数据和声明的操作需求中识别并分析简化随机可用性模型的算法。该识别过程构建执行状态的联合分布规律，并在观测不完整的情况下保留兼容的分布规律。形式化的结果确立了可达到的概率界限，以及直接识别“完成与截止期限”表示所需满足的条件。这一构造保留了在完整模型中评估同一“完成与截止期限”事件所获得的取值范围；另有一个独立的联合比较用于描述被舍弃的结构信息。一项独立研究涵盖了三个微服务应用和18次实验活动。在完整……
tldr: 本文提出从遥测数据和声明的操作需求中识别简化随机可用性模型的算法，通过形式化分析给出可达到的概率界限，并证明该简化模型能够保留完整模型中对“完成-截止期限”事件的评估范围。
en_tdlr: This paper presents algorithms for identifying a reduced stochastic availability model from telemetry and declared operation requirements, establishing attainable probability bounds through formal analysis and proving that the reduced model preserves the completion-and-deadline evaluation range obtained from the full model.
